arguments.sql:
SELECT l.DNA, typeof(l."DNA-II") AS level_type, MIN(l."DNA-II") AS min_level, MAX(l."DNA-II") AS max_level, MIN(l.Date) AS first_date, COUNT(*) AS tests
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+' AND (l.DNA IS NOT NULL OR l."DNA-II" IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY l.DNA, typeof(l."DNA-II")
ORDER BY tests DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l."Date") AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)

    p.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) DESC, l."Date" ASC
LIMIT 1;
